coder_notes: EARLY_PHASE1 (Phase 0) record: translational subset. Population is 'high-grade gliomas (III and IV)' with no explicit glioblastoma mention; coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named on the basis that grade IV glioma without IDH requirement is historical glioblastoma (D27C), flagged uncertain; alternative is high_grade_glioma_unspecified (exclude). Aminolevulinic acid (SONALA-001, IV) is a sonodynamic sensitiser activated by MRgFUS: candidate with device_dependent true; formulation_flag new_route (IV vs oral). Arm D is MRgFUS alone (device only, no agent). Arm E MGMT requirement is inferred from 'unmethylated HGG' (MGMT not named explicitly). Pharmacodynamic tissue markers (cleaved caspase-3, oxidative stress, MIB-1) reflect SDT effect; candidate_matched set false as these are not selection biomarkers and the manual's matching examples concern target-selection markers.
